sentences.en: Yanni was on probation for something he did four months ago.
sentences.zh: Yanni 因四个月前做过的事正处于缓刑期。

sentences.en: The end of my probation period is nearing.
Sami didn't want to be on disciplinary probation.
sentences.zh: 萨米不想处于纪律观察期内。

senses.zh: 缓刑(期), (以观后效的)察看 试用(期), 试读(期)

mnemonic: 词根记忆：prob（证明）+ation→证明能力→试用
